disclosures: This system is for quantitative research and is not investment advice.
Historical results are simulated and are not live trading performance.
The current universe construction remains exposed to survivorship bias.
Neither approved research policy is approved for live deployment.

factor_exposure.disclosure: These are Salarium technical factor proxies, not canonical Fama-French factor returns.

methodology.market_beta_60d: Rolling 60-observation beta to the equal-weight universe return, minimum 40 observations.

excluded_features.return_5d: Excluded from the preferred model because it duplicates momentum_5d in the liquid-500 feature dataset.
